text.en:
Appropriation of funds. The sum equivalent to one-half (1/2) of all Current Operating
Expenditures and Capital Outlays appropriations in Presidential Decree No. 733 for each agency is hereby
appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the operation of the
government of the Republic of the Philippines during the period from July 1st to December 31st, 1976:
PROVIDED, That the amounts thus appropriated for capital outlays shall constitute a lump-sum for
"Miscellaneous Capital Outlays" which is hereby created and shall be used to support capital requirements of
such programs and projects of agencies as may be approved by the President.

Personal Services and Special Budgets. The itemization of appropriations for each agency
appearing in Presidential Decree No. 7 and its accompanying Itemization of Personal Services are hereby
made applicable for the period July 1st to December 31st, 1976. All lump-sum appropriations and special
provisions for each agency, as well as all funds appearing in Presidential Decree No. 733 are hereby
reauthorized, but not only to the extent as provided in Section 1 hereof: PROVIDED, That all Special Budgets
chargeable against said lump-sum appropriations in Presidential Decree No. 733 and which are herein
reauthorized are hereby made applicable also for the period from July 1st to December 31st, 1976.

Continuing Capital outlays. Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, the
appropriations for capital outlays provided in this Decree which are actually released to the agencies
concerned, shall be available for expenditure until the projects are completed.

General Provisions. The General Provisions in Presidential Decree No. 733 are hereby
authorized to apply from July 1st to December 31st, 1976: PROVIDED, That the Commissioner of the Budget
is hereby authorized to review the general provisions in Presidential Decree No. 733 and to propose to the
President such provisions which are to be reauthorized, including new provisions: PROVIDED FURTHER,
That such General Provisions as may be approved by the President shall be considered part of this Decree.

Rules and Regulations. The Commissioner of the Budget is hereby authorized to promulgate
rules and regulations for the implementation of this Decree, subject to the approval of the President of the
Philippines.

Effective Date. This Decree shall take effect on July 1st, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of March in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
